finding_groups.name: Unused global management reset
finding_groups.reason: Both paths enter the 50 MHz MMCM/PLL reset chains. Routed fanin evidence explicitly identifies reset_storage[0] and reset_wr_stb; frozen source initializes both to zero and asserts soc_rst only on a reset CSR write. Normal operation does not write this CSR; guarded spare host rejects R_MEMCAL+0x2000. Accepted ONLY with this operational exclusion. This does not qualify arbitrary management reset pulses; recover by full configuration reload or power cycle.

finding_groups.name: CSR FIFO gray pointers
finding_groups.reason: Ten registered binary-to-Gray pointer groups for AW/W/B/AR/R. Selected counter and synchronizer source matches the reviewed reference. The exact routed audit checks thirty source bits, both ASYNC_REG stages, direct fanins and clock domains; its facts match the reference. finding_groups.name: Vendor SmartConnect payload crossing
finding_groups.reason: Three paths terminate in generated async-converter write/read payload synchronization banks. These are AXI transactions held by the vendor asynchronous conversion protocol, not arbitrary independently changing payload bits. Accepted as generated SmartConnect IP with supplied constraints, reviewed interface clock/reset wiring and passing independent OOB timing. Implementation is encrypted; no source-level handshake proof is claimed. Physical PCIe and resets remain qualification tasks.

finding_groups.name: CSR AsyncFIFO storage
finding_groups.reason: 96 warnings cover distributed storage_16/17/19/20 payload read/write crossings for AW/W/AR/R. Frozen generated source gates writes and reads with FIFO full/empty, transfers registered Gray pointers through two stages, and holds stored words until consumption. Constraint file bounds payload paths by destination period; independent timing passed. Additional routed Gray-skew review bounds pointer propagation. Under this FIFO protocol a valid consumed word is stable; warnings about possible unconstrained RAM collision are reviewed within that operating protocol, not waived for raw direct RAM access.

calibration_flag_review: Exact routed fanin, independent cal0/cal1 two-stage ASYNC_REG chains and 100 MHz destination clocks match the reviewed reference.
operating_limitations: Do not write the unused global SoC reset CSR at R_MEMCAL+0x2000; supported transports reject it.
Keep the supplied clock topology and generated IP; use full configuration reload or power cycle for whole-design reset.
Vendor SmartConnect internals are encrypted; acceptance relies on the generated IP integration contract, not source-level or formal proof.
CH0 has no ECC. External DDR pad timing, supply margin, cold starts and runtime reliability remain unqualified.
RAM-only passes do not qualify this full implementation; PCIe DMA, matmul and inference still need physical tests.
